facts.business: Kaarya Facilities and Services Limited provides facilities management and related services.

auditor.name: Piyush Kothari & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: i) Outstanding statutory liabilities (GST Rs 758.28 lacs, Challenged before Appellate Authority Rs 425.00 lacs) with non-provision of interest leading to overstatement of profit. ii) Gratuity provision not made for field staff/temporary employees, variance with AS-15, impact unascertained. iii) Balance confirmations not received/reconciled for certain Trade Receivables, Trade Payables and other balances, subject to confirmation and consequential adjustments.

key_risks: Outstanding statutory liabilities with non-provision of interest
Incomplete gratuity provision for field staff/temporary employees
Unconfirmed/unreconciled trade receivables, payables and other balances
